# Let's use run_command or urllib/requests via python script to get the wikipedia raw text for Moon and Eliud Kipchoge.
cmd = '''python -c "
import urllib.request
import json

# Fetch Moon wikitext
url = 'https://en.wikipedia.org/w/api.php?action=parse&page=Moon&prop=wikitext&format=json'
req = urllib.request.Request(url, headers={'User-Agent': 'Mozilla/5.0'})
res = urllib.request.urlopen(req)
data = json.loads(res.read().decode('utf-8'))
wt_moon = data['parse']['wikitext']['*']

for line in wt_moon.splitlines():
    if 'perigee' in line.lower():
        print('Moon perigee:', line)

# Fetch Kipchoge wikitext or world record marathon pace
url_k = 'https://en.wikipedia.org/w/api.php?action=parse&page=Eliud_Kipchoge&prop=wikitext&format=json'
req_k = urllib.request.Request(url_k, headers={'User-Agent': 'Mozilla/5.0'})
res_k = urllib.request.urlopen(req_k)
data_k = json.loads(res_k.read().decode('utf-8'))
wt_k = data_k['parse']['wikitext']['*']

for line in wt_k.splitlines():
    if 'marathon' in line.lower() and ('record' in line.lower() or '2:0' in line.lower() or '1:59' in line.lower()):
        print('Kipchoge:', line)
"'''
res = await run_command(cmd)
print(res)
